name: uCable AI
about: Artificial intelligence: LLM and model releases and comparisons (Claude/Opus, Kimi, Gemini, GPT), AI agents and coding assistants, AI industry and company news, safety and interpretability, AI policy and economics, talks about AI products. E.g. Cloud Codes, O'Reilly, Salvatore Sanfilippo's AI videos, Anthropic/OpenAI/Google announcements

name: uCable Codice
about: Programming and software engineering craft, not AI news: languages (C, Rust, PHP, JavaScript), operating systems, system design, algorithms, devops, open-source tools, developer careers and culture, coding streams and rants. E.g. ThePrimeagen / The PrimeTime, Coding Jesus, Amigoscode, offlinemark, Melting Bots, InfoQ, Casey Muratori

name: uCable Tech
about: New consumer technology: smartphone, laptop and PC hardware reviews, unboxings, gadgets, tech news and comparisons of this year's products. E.g. Marques Brownlee, Mrwhosetheboss, Linus Tech Tips, Hardware Canucks, Otto Climan, TELEFONINO.NET, GiampyTek's new-gadget videos

name: uCable Retro
about: Retro technology and nostalgia: old Windows versions and betas, Windows CE, old phones and gadgets, 'N years later' retrospectives, retro PCs, frutiger aero and Y2K aesthetic, tech history. NOT reviews of new products. E.g. Datastream, WinClient5270, The 8-Bit Guy, bub hub, 91Tech

name: uCable Game
about: Video games and nerd culture: gameplay and walkthroughs, game and console news, game reviews, football games like FIFA/FC/PES, trading card games (Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh, Pokémon), comics and manga news, streamer highlights and just-chatting. E.g. PLAYERINSIDUE, 8 - BIT, Dario Moccia, MikeShowSha, KekkZ

name: uCable Amarcord
about: Italian television nostalgia and archive footage: old TV commercial sequences and spot compilations (Italia 1, Canale 5, Rete 4, La7), vintage TG and TV clips from the 80s to 2000s, old cartoon openings, channel idents, old city and street footage (e.g. Torino 1997). E.g. Canale42 2003&CO, Teo DeCitano, Archivioso, Ximo | Canale57

name: uCable Musica
about: Songs and music videos, live performances and concerts, covers, indie, rock, alternative, pop and Italian pop, singer-songwriters, lyric videos, music news and artist stories. Single tracks: not long mixes, not rap freestyles

name: uCable Rap
about: Rap, trap and hip-hop: Italian and international tracks, freestyles and live sessions (64 Bars), hyperpop and underground rap, rapper stories and album talk. E.g. Red Bull Droppa, Slitherich, 4 The Culture, TRASH 新 ドラゴン

name: uCable Night
about: Long mixes and playlists (usually over 40 minutes) to leave on in the background: ambient, lofi, vaporwave, frutiger aero mixes, study or sleep music, math rock playlists, DJ sets, jungle and liquid DnB mixes, 'white girl music' playlists, motivational loops

name: uCable Studio
about: Making music: production, mixing and songwriting breakdowns, producers' stories, instruments and gear (guitar, bass, amps, drums, synths, VCV Rack), music theory, DAWs like FL Studio, home studio tips. E.g. Benn Jordan, Mix with the Masters, Davie504, Daniel Wall, 12tone

name: uCable Calcio
about: Football: Serie A and Juventus news, match highlights and reactions, Milan, Napoli and Roma analysis, transfers, national team, legends and old matches (Totti, Del Piero, Ronaldinho), Real Madrid, Ballon d'Or, football stories and podcasts. E.g. Juventus, Romeo Agresti, Daniele Brogna, Cronache di Spogliatoio, colo99, Gobbo Maltese

name: uCable Motori
about: Cars and motorsport: Formula 1 and Ferrari, MotoGP, car reviews and tests, supercars, classic cars, car culture, Top Gear. E.g. Automoto.it, Top Gear, TechDrive

name: uCable Fitness
about: Fitness, nutrition and health: workouts, bodybuilding, diets, protein and food rankings, sleep, testosterone, doctors explaining health topics, fitness meal prep. E.g. Noah Asemota, GianzCoach, Jalalsamfit

name: uCable Mente
about: Self-improvement and psychology: habits, focus, productivity routines, relationships and dating advice, emotional maturity, anxiety, ADHD, philosophy of life, thought experiments, motivation, minimalism. E.g. Mark Manson, The School of Life, Rian Doris, Dott. Valerio Rosso, Rick DuFer, Big Think

name: uCable Business
about: Startups and entrepreneurship: indie hacking, app and SaaS revenue stories, founder interviews, company building, business case studies, brand histories, tech company history. E.g. Starter Story, Simon Squibb, Chapeau, Marcello Ascani, Storie di Brand

name: uCable Soldi
about: Personal finance and consumer rights: ETFs and investing, savings, taxes, mortgages, banks, salaries, pensions, legal questions answered by lawyers (Italian law). E.g. Matteo Ongaro, Mr. RIP, Avv. Angelo Greco

name: uCable Attualità
about: News, politics and economics commentary: Italian and international current affairs, war reports (Ukraine, Middle East), protests, elections, geopolitics, analysis of the week's events. E.g. Breaking Italy, Michele Boldrin, Davide Montingelli, Daniele Fabbri, Salvatore Sanfilippo's political opinions

name: uCable Radio
about: Talk radio, podcasts and long conversations: La Zanzara, One More Time, Pulp Podcast, interviews with personalities, call-in shows, weekly live chats, podcast episodes. E.g. Zanzara Republic, I Bellissimi di Zanzara, Il Caffettino di Mario Moroni, Luca Casadei, Lex Fridman

name: uCable Comedy
about: Comedy: sketches, stand-up, parody, try-not-to-laugh, funny compilations, Italian TV comedy (Gialappa's Band, Zelig, Roast in Peace), pranks, reaction humour, skits

name: uCable Cinema
about: Films and TV series: movie scenes and clips, trailers, recaps, series like Skins, Friends, House M.D., movie analysis, behind the scenes. E.g. Boxoffice, Skins

name: uCable Food
about: Cooking and eating: recipes, restaurants, food challenges, snack and fast-food taste tests, Italian cuisine, street food, food vlogs. E.g. Space Valley, Cosa mangiamo oggi?, marta daddato's food videos, Cucina con Ruben

name: uCable Vlog
about: Vlogs and personal stories: travel and expat life, day in the life, city trips, fragrance and lifestyle vlogs, studying abroad, moving countries, personal updates. E.g. Carlo and Bailey, Lana Blakely, sandrino, michelle puttini, FedeCupp

name: uCable Misteri
about: Mysteries and strange stories: abandoned places and urbex, true crime and unsolved cases, ghost towns, bizarre science and 'strangest things' documentaries, medical case stories, extreme explorations. E.g. Stringer media, Science Channel, Chubbyemu, Strange Evidence

name: uCable Scienza
about: Science and education explainers: biology, animals, space, geology, physics, chemistry, mathematics, history, Italian popular science. E.g. Geopop, Barbascura eXtra, La Fisica Che Ci Piace, Big Think science talks, ElectroBOOM

name: uCable Design
about: Design and architecture: interiors, house tours, product and industrial design, icon and UI design, design news and talent shows. E.g. Architectural Digest, Caffè Design, Letterform Archive

name: uCable Zapping
about: Anything that fits none of the other channels: odd compilations, social experiments and reaction clips, brand promos and ads, miscellaneous finds
